meta.description: Per-model rf-mcp instruction-quality baselines for the agentic e2e gate. Lowering a number here is a human-reviewed ratchet: it means rf-mcp's tool descriptions / MCP instructions got measurably worse for a fixed model. Only scenarios marked _validated:true hard-gate (calibrated + monotonic-sensitive per the validation canary). Recapture with E2E_CAPTURE_BASELINE=1.
meta.aggregation: median for rates, mean for completion
meta.capture_command: MINIMAX_API_KEY=... E2E_CAPTURE_BASELINE=1 E2E_RUNS=5 E2E_MODELS=MiniMax-M3 uv run pytest tests/e2e/test_minimax_autonomous.py

reference_pin.note: GOAL: a pinnable self-hostable reference (qwen3-coder-30b, single 24GB GPU @ Q4) to kill baseline drift. FINDING (apply): OpenRouter DEFAULT routing for qwen3-coder is NOT reproducible — it intermittently returns prose with ZERO tool calls (N=3: success [0,0,1]). Realizing the self-hostable reference requires OpenRouter provider PINNING or actual self-hosting; until then MiniMax-M3 is the active reference (proven 3/3 reliable) and open-weight models run inform-only for trend.

roster_notes.z-ai/glm-4.7-flash: #1 hard_gate promotion candidate — most reliable tool-caller of the self-hostable set (called tools on all 4 technologies, no zero-call flake, fast). Promote after an N>=5 reliable capture (ideally self-hosted).
roster_notes.qwen/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct: aspirational self-hostable reference; strong on data_driven/xml/suite but a recurring API zero-call flake reproduces the [0,0,1] finding even under a Novita provider pin — inform-only until self-hosted N-run capture.
roster_notes.mistralai/mistral-small-3.2-24b-instruct: functional but weak (flails: 78 calls on xml, low success); trend only.
roster_notes.google/gemma-3-27b-it: EXCLUDED — zero tool calls on all 4 technologies (broken tool-calling, same class as llama-3.1-8b).

desktop_discovery._canary: INVALID (2026-07-20, MiniMax-M3): degradation INVERTED the metric (hit 0.67->1.00, first 0.00->1.00) — pure-discovery task, no execution critical path, blanking descriptions removed distraction. good first_try=0.00 also indicates the expected-tool set is mis-mapped. Not recoverable as a hard-gate probe; keep inform or rebuild as an execution scenario.
